title.label: Tried the rest. This is the best

content.label: Really nice to use.

title.label: No longer the best podcast playing app

content.label: A decent player, that used to be the best, but the UI was updated long ago now which made it worse. No ability to sort podcasts, or have an unplayed episode count of each podcast. I just want a list of my subscribed podcasts showed in list view with a made count on each podcast telling me hire many unplayed episodes there are.

title.label: My favorite podcast app by far

content.label:
Overcast has been my podcast player of choice for years and it remains my favorite to this day.

With iOS 26 around the corner, I was concerned about the upcoming update. With the final version of iOS 26 in place, I updated to it and then updated Overcast.

The iOS redesign lands well, balancing the new design paradigm with the established design language of Overcast and how the user experience flows.

Thanks for continuing to produce a great independent podcast app that I feel good about supporting, Marco.

I’ve been using Overcast since… forever. It’s beautifully designed and it’s built and maintained by a real human, not a faceless corporation.

Marco really cares about his software and it shows. Overcast’s preferences enable you to set everything up just the way you like it. There’s even a section for ‘Nitpicky Details’.

If you’re looking for a podcast player, look no further, you’ve found it.
Now missing from my Apple Watch…what have I done wrong?
Ask your users whether they want the change, don’t just do it.
Like the new icon and other ui tweaks. Still the best podcast player and it keeps on improving.

title.label: Don’t buy, recent updates ruin it

content.label:
Terrible UI design now. Buggy beyond belief. Can’t ueven do next podcast quickly.

Update. Surprised it’s even worse. Think marco has had some sort of breakdown to do this.

I use this app daily. Excellent functionality from a developer that obviously cares about form and function. 

Best feature: “Go back” - this “undo” feature has saved me so much time so many times. 

Personally, I don’t like the decision to make blue chapter titles take you to the linked article - I would prefer if only the circled-arrow icon was the hyperlink. 

Despite this minor functionality disagreement I still think it’s the best podcast app I’ve seen on any platform.

title.label: The reason i’m sill on iPhone

content.label:
I use Overcast every single day, and could not be without it.  Initially arriving with innovative time saving features, Overcast has matured into THE podcast app.
Marco, the developer is also a pretty awesome guy, and can be found on his own ATP podcast, where he’ll explain why updates for IOS26 have been so problematic for all developers.

The only podcast app I use now, great url podcast upload so easy to use
I listen to over 50 hours of Dan carlins hardcore history and only 1 problem when you are listening to some thing while downloading it the app will sometimes switch to other episodes which you have downloaded but other than that nothing has gone greatly wrong, great app

I pay for the premium version and it’s a bargain even with the price increase. I use this app every single day and it’s completely reliable, simple to use, and it has niche features that I can find in any other podcast app. I’m happy to pay a bit more for such a well developed and consistently maintained app.
Just when you think you’ve mastered this podcast player, they issue a new release and you need to start over.  Good luck configuring the playback order of your podcasts and remaining satisfied.

title.label: Great phone app, terrible watch app

content.label: The phone app is a 5/5. The Watch app sadly seems to have turned into a bit of a disaster. Downloads no longer sync, half of them fail and the remainder just get stuck on waiting to download despite multiple charge cycles and reinstallls of the app! This was my go to podcast app because I could go for a run without my phone and still listen to my podcasts, but it looks like I’ll have to find something else for the Watch
This was the best iPhone podcast app which I have enjoyed for many years, but recently it stopped downloading podcasts which renders it totally useless. Don’t waste your time downloading this app.

title.label: How to ruin an excellent app

content.label: Have used and loved Overcast for many years now. However, since the Watch app rewrite it is a complete lottery whether any podcasts get downloaded to the Watch. I haven’t changed any settings it just doesn’t work anymore.

Whilst I like the new Apple Watch redesign, it has removed the ability to stream over cellular, and episodes are no longer downloading whilst my Apple Watch is on charge. Quite frustrating as I like to use this for podcasts whilst running but this is no longer possible. Hoping the developer can fix this soon as I’ve used the app for years and it’s one of my favourites.

Update on this - the new version just does this all the time. 

Deletes everything then tries to download EVERYTHING again.

For older podcasts I cherished and are now no longer available - thanks terrible podcast app for bringing back oral storytelling tradition I guess, as these pods are now just myths and legends in the ether.

Original review

The app is good…except when from time to time it seems to delete every podcast downloaded, then tries to redownload them all again.

Its happened twice now in the last few months, entirely randomly - eating up a months data and loosing me archived podcasts that no longer exist (including one on which i was a guest, and is lost forever now. 

Thats a huge bug, so on that alone I’d avoid this.

Subscription jumped from £8.99 to £14.99 (67% increase), so I’ll not be renewing, which is a shame as I’d still like to support the developer. 
It’s still a 5 star app. 

Previous: Since the days of Real Player, I have used the majority of podcast players and this one has become my favourite. 
It’s well designed and simple. The ability to easily set up playlists, the granular control and the audio quality all contribute to the well deserved 5 Stars.

title.label: If only it worked on Apple Watch!

content.label: Great app, but doesn’t work on Apple Watch. Just keeps saying “open overcast on your iPhone to continue” which is really frustrating as the app is open. Tried deleting and redownloading and still not working. No technical support so forced to leave a bad review instead. Shame as the app seems fantastic.

title.label: Apple watch app not downloading episodes

content.label: Update deleted everything and now it's terrible at downloading to watch. Ask we need is you to make sure the podcasts are there to listen to. Ui speed or little tweaks are irrelevant if it doesn't do its core functionality

title.label: New watch app made downloads unreliable

content.label: The latest version of the Watch app removed all my existing downloads and seems unreliable. My podcasts are no longer being automatically downloaded while my watch is charging overnight. I hope this can be fixed soon because I primarily pay for the app for the watch integration.

The iPhone app is sensational but why remove the ability to stream over cellular for the watch app? I like to go running without my phone and the ability to just stream my smart playlist is one I cherish!

“Open Overcast on your iPhone to continue.” Press the arrow and it quickly fails. That’s all Overcast can do now on my Ultra. The process fails every time. I’ve restarted my watch many times now and tried every other trick I can think of there and on the iPhone. Hopefully Marco’s aware of the problem. 

I’ve quite an Overcast subscriptions list after all these years. I can understand the onboarding sync would be slow. But timing out like this is a literal showstopper. 

I’m still looking forward to the long awaited rewrite of the Watch version of Overcast. I prefer listening to podcasts there than always bringing my iPhone. For the time being, that no longer works.

The most recent update is welcome after a hiatus. My wish list: (a) in lists, be able to drag multiple episodes together; (b) in playback view, add the following to the two existing swipe screens in the carousel: audio-settings screen & podcast-settings screen; (c) a new option for a period of silence of "x" seconds settings between episodes during continuous playback ("x" being user-definable per podcast).

I’ve used this app since it first launched. Smartspeed is a fantastic feature that’s worked throughout every version and rewrite. If you want to support an indie by paying for a great podcast app - this is the app for you.
Loving the new look and feel - great app and easy to use.

The issue is now fixed and my default podcast app again.

Scrolling through chapters is broken and leads to accidental taps. I’ve had to move to PocketCast for podcasts with chapters.

title.label: App back to what it used to be …

content.label:
Update: it took a while but I think we are back to the slick app we knew and loved back when we started using it. Thanks Marco 

- - - - - - - - 

Marco, what have you done?? You took something that was brilliant and broke it. The app is now super messy. It used to be easy to go to the podcast, mark something as listened to etc and now this is super complicated. Please bring back the old app. It was so much better.

title.label: Used up monthly data allowance after updating the app

content.label: Recently updated the app, then a few days later had a text from my mobile provider that I’d used up the 25gb of monthly data allowance! Didn’t change any settings other than update the app.
Excellent

title.label: Downloads still unreliable since the rewrite

content.label: I’ve given this app a LOT of time now and it still doesn’t reliably download every podcast. Every week there’s some problem or error and I have to futz with cancel download, hit download again to try to get it unstuck. Old app was completely bulletproof. Please fix Marco.

title.label: It was so good, rewrite is so buggy

content.label:
I don’t understand what’s happened, the author is well known in Apple circles for quality stuff. It seems the rewrite using latest Swift is confirming that the ecosystem is just is too complicated.

It used to crash all the time, this got fixed after many long weeks and it had a moment of stability but again I’m updating the review as it constantly stops and shows a spinner (buffering?) meaning no sound for content that’s supposed to be downloaded. My partner complains hers doesn’t automatically download anymore (I can’t see any setting issues for why).

It’s a shame.
The settings and features are so much better than the default podcast app that came with my phone. Bands down
Scrolling through chapters instantly selects them. Infuriating.

title.label: From the best to full of bugs

content.label: I’ve used Overcast for years, so it’s really sad to see how the app has declined, and how arrogant and blind the developer is to all the issues. I have cancelled my subscription, and don’t recommend this app to anyone.
Can’t even search for anything. Useless.

Everything is amazing! But the standout feature for me is syncing between devices. I have two devices and they sync flawlessly every time. Awesomeness. EDIT: Look how old my original review is! I was blown away by syncing! The new design is really nice. Great work. And look at the file size! 14MB! That is some efficient work. Overcast continues to be the standard for design efficiency and technical robustness. Brilliant.

I’ve sadly had to leave Overcast after years of use. Mainly because of the change to how the podcasts load. I’m not sure what has happened but i frequently get podcasts starting and then cutting off midway through. Sad to leave.

title.label: Many bugs still after rewrite which don’t seem to be being fixed in favour of niche bells & whistles

content.label:
* Ranked High-Priority and Date orders are frequently ignored when new episodes are inserted to smart playlists, with episodes inserted in an arbitrary order into the playlist (I have recent screenshots from the many recent times I’ve reported this in TestFlight, in-app, and on a couple of occasions Mastadon). 
* Similarly an excluded High-Priority episode that is added back to the playlist is always added to the top, not by its Ranked High-Priority order. 
* Newly subscribed podcast episodes are inserted above High-Priority episodes when they are initially added to the playlist, should be below High-Priority list. 
* Resuming playback will sometimes not resume the previously playing episode and will instead play the next episode by priority (gets that bit correct, at least!). 
* Playback sometimes does not pause when removing AirPods. 
* Overcast does not show in Now Playing widget on Lock Screen after connecting to audio device e.g. AirPods, other Bluetooth audio device.
* Overcast sometimes does not play through CarPlay, requiring the app to be quit and reopened on the iPhone (though this may be a CarPlay bug, or at least this same issue exists in Spotify).
* Current Podcast list no longer shows podcasts with played episodes which have not been deleted (this was Overcast’s previous behaviour and also the way the Podcast information page still works).
* The horizontal playlist carousel looks bad more than ~3 playlists. 
* The horizontal playlist carousel is functionally poor with more than ~3 playlists.
* Downloads do not always happen in the background - I will receive a notification for an episode, open it some time after receiving it, and the episode shows Waiting to Download.
* On the Add Podcast screen, tapping the description text does not expand this to show the full text where it is truncated.

This was & can still be a good app but the radio silence & self-satisfied stance towards ongoing issues is not okay.
I don’t want this invasive rubbish
Far and away the best podcast app, which is unsurprising given the developer’s pedigree. What happens when an awesome developer single-handedly makes and maintains a killer product.

title.label: The smart playlists are a game changer!

content.label: I haven’t liked the Apple podcast format for a while but couldn’t use it any more after the latest 14.5.1 update . It’s awful! I looked into other podcast providers. I listen to podcasts for around 8 hours per day. Castro was recommended for heavy podcast users. I tried it but didn’t find it all that user friendly and it wasn’t much of an improvement on the iOS version. Then I tried Overcast. It’s perfect! Simple, easy & very clear. Things are sorted neatly and there is no stress. The best feature is smart playlists. You set up a smart playlist, give it a title like ‘sports’ add your sports podcasts to it - your sports podcast will download straight to that playlist - you can select how you group them, newest to oldest or sorted by podcast series, probably a few more options too - you can select priority podcasts within the playlist so that they always go straight to the top. It’s perfect, simple and easy to use. Things are sorted how I want them to be.

I’m a long time user of Overcast but recently there’s been an annoying bug. It usually happens when I try to fast forward 30 seconds. But sometimes when I’m just playing without ff. The app stops playing the episode and defaults back to a previous one. It happens so often that I’m using other podcast apps these days.
Works well and is simple to use, does everything I want, highly recommend this app.

After many, many years of happily using Overcast and recommending it to others, the experience has been ruined for me by the major update last year. It’s riddled with lots of small bugs now, and it’s clear from the update cadence that the developer isn’t focused on it (I read somewhere that he’s opening a restaurant?!). To add insult to injury, immediately after releasing the terrible update he increased the subscription price, and has been pretty arrogant about it being underpriced and saying he’s going to keep increasing it each year until he feels it’s the right level.

This used to be the best podcast app by a long way, but unfortunately I can no longer recommend it. The good news is nowadays there are lots of other good options to try.

title.label: Why did I wait so long?

content.label: From day one, I used Apple’s Podcasts app. And from day one I watched it degrade into a content-pushing mess. Overcast cares about the podcasts you actually listen to and devotes its interface to making that experience great. Individual podcast settings, with speed control and intro skip, are worth the sub alone. Tiny features, like the little back-skip when resuming from interruption, are what make this app top notch. And you can have the vast majority of it for nowt! Use it for a week and you’ll be hooked.
Since the last major update, I’ve been experiencing constant issues with downloads failing or not being found. It’s really frustrating when I go to listen and the files aren’t there.

How is it possible to create such frustratingly annoying ux to navigate what are essentially just audio files. Still I’ve stuck with this app for too long to change. More annoyingly though, is that recently it frequently hangs when accessed via CarPlay. The ui fails to load on the CarPlay screen. When unlocking the phone and opening the app, is almost always in a hung state and has to be force quit.  This seems related to the latest versions of iOS.
Lot’s of useful extras, it’s fantastic.
